property_snapshot.Garrison: Town council (merchant-dominated). Small constabulary — bridge toll collection and basic law enforcement. Merchant Trust standing guard detachment. No standing military. Population in the low thousands. NRTC transit volume the dominant economic activity. Sage Kellam resident (former Avowed, weekly Waterdeep sessions).
property_snapshot.Name: Millbridge & Millbridge Merchant Trust
property_snapshot.Notes: Long Road bridge town north of Waterdeep. Midway banking waypoint between Waterdeep and northern trade routes. Merchant Trust holds NRTC accounts: Shi'van's 25% stake = 225gp accumulated. Also holds Branden Consolidated manifest records (= B. Taranis = Arik's supply chain, 15% volume increase last quarter). Mithril Hall opportunity (Dolgrin Coalmantle proposal, 8-12 shipments/month at 2-5k gp avg, 800-3,000 gp/mo revenue potential) routes through here. Quentin Shaw (Yartar factor) locked 3 of 6 corridor waystations (Dessarin Ford, Bargewright Inn, Ironford). Marcus Ironhand authorized 2,000gp to secure the remaining 3 (Thornhold, Amphail junction, Rassalantar) before 28th Eleasis. Shaw identity unknown — Firth investigating. Sage Kellam Brightwater (former Candlekeep Avowed) resides here, travels weekly to Waterdeep for Slime consultations.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Master Silverhair (primary). Marcus Ironhand (metalwork apprentice). Elena Brightforge (precision apprentice). Shi'van (25% profit share on independent work, uses workshop regularly). No standing security beyond DC 25 commercial locks — Silverhair's 800-year reputation and his Laeral Silverhand relationship are the actual deterrent.
property_snapshot.Name: Silverhair Artistic Metals
property_snapshot.Notes: Master Elwyn Silverhair's workshop. Castle Ward, Waterdeep. 800-year moon elf master smith. Partner facility to Institut. Shi'van's primary metalworking mentor. Site of Eye of Verðandi collaboration (complete Phase 5), Eye of Dagaz in progress, Verðandi Collar forged here, Laeral Silverhand's 40 ward anchors made here. Deep iron specimen under analysis (dual-band, BCC matrix x3.2 amplification). Mithril Wire Drawing Bench + Exotic Material Working Suite onsite. Silverhair's Laeral access is how Shi'van first came onto the Open Lord's radar.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Proprietor (elf of uncertain but clearly not-young age, long institutional history of elven ownership, soft-voiced, emotionally aware of the common room, known to regulars by name, called 'the keeper' by strangers). Bartender (traditionally the proprietor himself, with junior assistance from sun-elf woman in her second century at peak evenings, institutional memory for patrons — returning after a decade, patron's preferred wine is remembered). Kitchen: half-elven cook + 2 elven assistants. Rotating musician roster (resident harpist 4 nights/week; other instruments occasional; traveling performers when they come through). No standing martial garrison — the tavern's protection is institutional respectability, permanent sound-wards on private rooms, enchanted continual-light lamps (renewed by resident druid at quarterly maintenance), and the elven community's collective standing as a Waterdhavian population segment. 6 upper-floor guest rooms for traveling elves. Walled back garden \~40x30 ft (rowan, silver birches, herb plantings, stone bench) open to patrons in summer.
property_snapshot.Name: Elfstone Tavern
property_snapshot.Notes: Principal elven social establishment in Waterdeep. North Ward, 2-story stone-and-timber building, slate roof. Name from single polished moonstone set into silver lintel above front door (catches light unusually, blessed at establishment by High Priestess of the House of the Moon per local legend). Carved oak door with silver-inlay leaf-and-vine tracery. Interior: common room 50x25 ft, western-wall bar, aged oak paneling, tapestries of woodland scenes and abstracted leaf patterns, enchanted continual-light lamps, north-wall stone fireplace with carved mantle. Wine selection: Evermeet when available (increasingly rare), Cormanthor, Silver Marches, Silverymoon-area elvish vineyards. Elvish cuisine adapted for mixed clientele (breads, aged cheeses, cured meats, seasonal greens, honey-nut pastries). Quiet music most evenings (resident harpist 4 nights/week + rotating performers). Two sound-warded private dining rooms at rear for business/diplomatic/social privacy — rentable at premium. 6 upper-floor guest rooms for traveling elves. Back walled garden with rowan, silver birches, herb plantings. Tavern runs on implicit code of elven courtesy — does not refuse non-elven patrons but filters by self-selection; loud patrons find their drinks slow in arriving. Campaign relevance: Shi'van cannot visit directly (institutional elven-drow tensions too deep); Seren Nightbloom's moon-elf seamstress cover is ideal for ambient listening; Marcel Dior'Elle welcomed without being regular (sun-elf, Institut-aligned, can rent private rooms for commercial engagements); Pharyn Baen'und latent invitation potential through elven noble family channel; Cerulean Circle membership-overlap makes Elfstone second-best signal-propagation venue after direct Circle access; private rooms are rare North Ward sound-warded discreet-dining asset.
property_snapshot.Source File: WotC canon: Waterdeep and the North (2E), Volo's Guide to Waterdeep (2E), City of Splendors: Waterdeep (3.5E boxed set), various FR elven-community references.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Clan Stoneshaft (dwarven). Borgan Stonebreaker (seneschal), Vendra Goldmark (quartermaster), Hallund Ironpen (clerk). Independent clan counter-intelligence. Underdark-adjacent dwarven ground — Hunzrin does not have reliable observation here.
property_snapshot.Name: Stoneshaft Hold (Thornhold) — Dwarven Clan Anchor
property_snapshot.Notes: Dwarven clan hold on the Dessarin corridor. 'Thornhold' is the legacy reference name; STONESHAFT HOLD is canonical. Waystation support contract signed Session 35, 22nd Marpenoth 1493 DR (Day 728), at 120 gp/yr tripwire rate — southbound caravan anchor for the Yartar-avoiding corridor. Key personnel: Borgan Stonebreaker (seneschal), Vendra Goldmark (quartermaster), Hallund Ironpen (clerk). Shi'van deposited Margaster/Hunzrin intelligence; logged as clan-credit honoured at discretion. Received in exchange: mould-fault rubbing of forged Yartar Merchants' Guild seal used on Shaw/Hargrove credentials — identifies the single Margaster-sourced Waterdhavian forgery shop. Underdark-adjacent dwarven ground with independent counter-intelligence; Hunzrin has no reliable observation here. Jarlaxle/BD will register the contract via incidental trade observation \~Day 740. Merileth filing decision pending (public vs private) on the forgery rubbings; will determine Margaster arrival timing on the shop ID.
property_snapshot.Source File: PROP — Stoneshaft waystation contract (345e8214-84b0-819d); Day Sync Update S35 close (345e8214-84b0-8121); Quentin Hargrove NPC (341e8214-84b0-814d)

property_snapshot.Garrison: Early 1495 DR: \~800 Bloodaxe-affiliated security personnel on rotating deployment, Captain Gerald Westmont's immediate staff \~40, workshop / quartermaster / logistics / medical / crystal-network crews \~120 combined. \~2,000 construction workers (60% human, 30% dwarf, 10% other) in mixed barracks and tent encampments (non-military). Devil construction crews operate nights per Zariel contract. Expected full operational garrison: 5,000 troops + support.
property_snapshot.Name: Guardian's Gate Ziggurat
property_snapshot.Notes: Active multi-level ziggurat fortress under construction in the northeastern Neverwinter Woods pass. Design closes the pass entirely: 800 ft wide × 400 ft north-south × 200 ft deep excavation forming artificial mountain ziggurat with 4-level progression (Foundation Plateau / Rampart Terrace / Sustenance Circle / Command Apex) plus underground complex for 1,000+ personnel. Aluminum-cast artillery stockpiled for 5-mile-radius dominance. At Early 1495 DR \~Month 12-14 of 24-month supernatural-speed construction (Zariel devil-contract labor). Level 1 near complete; Level 2 active; Levels 3-4 planned. Secret contents: aluminum stockpile, preserved pre-elven Garden Keeper carvings, and (unknown to all parties) House Baen'und chronicle buried in southeast foundation corner. Four cosmological powers have converging interests: Arik (northern consolidation), Zariel (devil-labor proof-of-concept), Garden Keeper (ancient carvings attention), Odin (observed via Sister Catherine + raven network). Key personnel: Foreman Magnus Ironfoot (dwarf, careful ignorance), Captain Gerald Westmont (security, briefed on devils), Sister Catherine of Odin (shrine keeper, divine observer), Mysterious Supervisors (Arik's devil overseers). Active threats: weekly orc scouting probes, drow infiltration, supply sabotage, political opposition in Neverwinter, ancient disturbances from deep vault carvings.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No standing presence. Kenafin embedded asset (provisionally Thessaly Wren) serviced the drop until Day 620 dormancy. BD actively collecting (Kimmuriel Oblodra reading product). Firth not authorized for active surveillance at current campaign time. Second Kenafin operative in Waterdeep signaled distress at adjacent chalk mark (Blackstaff Alley/Nethpranter Row corner) — Seren's response deferred.
property_snapshot.Name: Nethpranter Street Dead Drop
property_snapshot.Notes: Kenafin embedded theological assessor's dead drop. Alley behind Coffinmaker's shop, Nethpranter Street, Waterdeep. Identified by Shi'van Session 21 via Thaelen Korr pipeline. Embedded asset provisionally identified as Thessaly Wren (Session 22 Chat 8, d20=18). Current status: DORMANT since Day 620 (final report at Plinth, not here). BD collecting from this drop — Session 33 reframe establishes BD as intermediate intelligence layer. Adjacent site: chalk mark at Blackstaff Alley/Nethpranter Row corner (distress signal from second Kenafin operative in Waterdeep, Session 28 Seren discovery).

property_snapshot.Garrison: Castle Waterdeep Griffon Cavalry (standing detachment at Mount Waterdeep Barracks at \~200 ft elevation on eastern face, working birds roosting at the Castle aerie, patrol upper slopes, serve as forward air-defense position). Four Walking Statues (massive stone constructs \~90 ft tall carved into mountain flanks at strategic elevations, dormant under normal conditions, activation by Open Lord authority or Archmage emergency writ only, last documented activation centuries past). Hermits, scholars from the Font of Knowledge, occasional climbers at middle and upper elevations (unregistered, tolerated, patrolled). No permanent settlement above residential-construction line. No standing martial garrison on upper mountain — the mountain's defense is its mass, its cliffs, its statues, and the Cavalry's aerial cover.
property_snapshot.Name: Mount Waterdeep
property_snapshot.Notes: The mountain that is Waterdeep's foundation. Single stone massif rising \~1000 ft from the coast at the city's western edge. Western face: sheer sea cliff (200-300 ft vertical to Sea of Swords, uncolonized, defensive). Eastern face: gradual slope into Castle Ward, residential construction up to a certain elevation then wild ground. Northern ridge meets Trollwalls; southern flank shelters harbor. Summit holds small stone shrine of uncertain dedication (predates surviving records, rebuilt many times). Castle Waterdeep at the mountain's eastern foot; Undermountain megadungeon beneath the mountain's mass (accessed via the Yawning Portal's Well — the canonical city-facing entry). Four Walking Statues carved into mountain flanks at strategic elevations (each \~90 ft tall humanoid stone construct animate in historical defense crises, dormant under normal conditions, activation restricted to Open Lord/Archmage authority). Mount Waterdeep Barracks at \~200 ft elevation houses Griffon Cavalry detachment. Mountain stone has been Waterdeep's building material for a thousand years — quarries on southern/eastern flanks provide ongoing supply. Baen Construction Waterdeep work uses Mount Waterdeep stone as standard. Campaign relevance: geographic grounding for all westward scenes, Undermountain access vector (latent), stone quarry baseline for construction economics, Griffon Cavalry latent institutional relationship through Castle Waterdeep command floor, symbolic backdrop for the city's foundational permanence.
property_snapshot.Source File: WotC canon: Waterdeep: Dragon Heist (5E), Dungeon of the Mad Mage (5E), City of Splendors: Waterdeep (3.5E), Volo's Guide to Waterdeep (2E), Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3E.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No standing garrison within the library itself. Asmodeus is sole resident principal. Ancillary staff: pit fiend administrative operators (resident in Nessus broadly; rarely present in the library during audiences). Corridor security detail: standing operatives executing evaluation protocols ('permitted attack' testing infrastructure) on visiting delegations — canonical, count unspecified, operating under standing orders. No mortal permanent residents; no mortal garrisoned forces; no ordinary population. All presence in the library is by Asmodeus's explicit summons or grant.
property_snapshot.Name: Nessus Library
property_snapshot.Notes: Audience chamber of Asmodeus, Lord of the Ninth. Sixty-foot circular library within Nessus (likely Malsheem proper; canonically unspecified). Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves spanning every civilization the Nine Hells have contacted across millennia; dark stone domed ceiling (unmarked, only textless surface); polished obsidian floor; uniform warm illumination from no visible source. Central desk in nearly-black wood with one open book, inkwell, and pen. No throne. Asmodeus appears as a man in his late fifties, brown eyes 'the color of good leather,' simple dark red robes, no regalia. **Canonical first audience (Asmodeus Audience Framework):** Arik + 21-member delegation; chairs pre-placed and sized to each delegate's measurements (grade from corridor evaluation testing); five-beat negotiation structure resulted in Warborn contract extension, Demiurge transfer framework (contingent), Dalelands war commitment from Arik, **no-predation mutual exclusion clause** (comprehensive ban on all cosmological predation within Baen sovereign territory, expands automatically with conquest, applies to all parties including Hell), and **one uncashed question** (any topic, answered truthfully by Asmodeus at Arik's timing — remains held). Asmodeus accepted the exclusion on long-horizon calculation that proof of mortal civilization operating outside divine-infernal framework is worth more than soul revenue exclusion costs. Corridor approach is evaluation zone (canonical 'permitted attack' testing). Scry-warding absolute. Minor location per page-schema (per-visit Model B ambient tables).
property_snapshot.Source File: Asmodeus Audience Framework Notion page `343e8214-84b0-8107-833a-c135dedd57d7` + project knowledge `session_log_inevitable_city.md`, `warborn-contract-implementation-plan.md`, `The_Demiurge_-_Prisoner_of_the_Screaming_Cliffs.md`

property_snapshot.Garrison: Master Goldweaver (Senior Appraiser, principal authority on high-value specimens, signature on ESAMT ruby certification at 1,010,000gp). Senior Masters' Council (12-member adjudicative body, meets monthly in second-floor chamber). Guild porter at the threshold during business hours. Three registry clerks at ground-floor desks. Night watchmen from guild's own staff. Registered member body including Shi'van Baen'und (Master Associate standing via Silverhair workshop profit-share). Archive and vault staff for third-floor secure storage. No standing martial garrison — security is institutional and procedural, backed by guild discipline, standard commercial-grade locks, and scrying-resistance on appraisal chambers.
property_snapshot.Name: House of Gems
property_snapshot.Notes: Jewelers' Guild Hall of Waterdeep. Diamond Street, Castle Ward. Three-story limestone building. Ground floor: public registry hall (clerks' desks, consultation benches, filing cabinets, members file new commissions and collect certifications here), locked registry vault holding master records back to the guild's charter. First floor: four private appraisal chambers along central corridor, soundproofed and scrying-warded, Master Goldweaver works from the corridor's northern chamber. Second floor: Senior Masters' Council meeting chamber, attached archive (charter documents, disciplinary records, master pattern book). Third floor: secure storage and working archive (pieces held in trust, appraisal-dispute holdings, reference specimens, active commission registry separate from public records). Master Goldweaver certified the flawless million-gold ruby anchoring the Enhanced Strategic Asset Management Trust (1,010,000gp) — the foundational appraisal on which Shi'van's 3,000,000gp borrowing capacity rests. Shi'van registered as Master Associate (via Silverhair workshop profit-share); all her commercial pieces (Evening's Edge, Verðandi Collar, Eye of Verðandi Phase 5, Eye of Dagaz in progress, protection-line commissions routing through the Atelier) are on the registry here. Session 8B decision 'all stones through guild registry — customer AND family editions, no exceptions' is operative institutional doctrine. Toril Shield Assurance's Guardian Pledge hypothecation uses the appraisal pipeline that runs through this Hall. Farid al-Rashid at Starfall Gems (Trades Ward nephew of the al-Rashid Calimshan mineral network) is an unresolved Institut-sponsorship thread that would route through House of Gems licensing.
property_snapshot.Source File: ESAMT Trust document (Merileth Dawntracker); Session 8B all-stones-through-registry decision; Session 22 Chat 5 al-Rashid/Farid surfacing; Silverhair Artistic Metals Commission Ledger.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Tower Commander (senior Waterdeep Guard Naval Detachment officer on extended Seatower rotation, reports to Castle Waterdeep naval command, authority over approach clearance and rapid-response deployment). Standing garrison \~50 personnel (3-month rotations). \~8 Signal Officers (flag-signal protocols, semaphore, lantern codes, messenger-bird dispatch, emergency communication — institutional memory of harbor-communication codes). \~6 Weapons Officers (ballista operation and maintenance, specialist training). \~8 Dockmaster and launch crew (supply dock, fast launch for pilot-skiff coordination and messenger deployment). Weapons: 3 ballistas standing deployment, 2 reserve (\~400 yard effective range), arrow-slit batteries permanently manned during watch, alert bells always ready. Three-month supply reserves (food, fresh water cistern, munitions, rope/rigging). Observation watch continuous — never pauses.
property_snapshot.Name: Seatower of Balaeros
property_snapshot.Notes: Harbor defense fortress at mouth of Deepwater Harbor. Stone tower on rocky islet \~200 yards off eastern harbor mouth. Islet \~100x60 yards, tower occupies most of habitable surface, small leeward supply dock. Tower 80 ft above islet peak (40 ft above high tide), granite construction matching Mount Waterdeep quarry, walls 15-20 ft thick at base, narrower at upper stories, slope-walled base for grappling resistance, first accessible level at \~25 ft. Five levels + rooftop: ground (supply cellar, water cistern, munitions, tunnel to dock), 1st-2nd (garrison quarters, officers, mess, armory, infirmary), 3rd (signal chamber — operational heart, command), 4th (weapons platform — ballistas, arrow batteries, alert bells), 5th + rooftop (observation, spyglasses, lantern array). Named for Lord Balaeros, historical Waterdhavian naval defender (details archived at Font of Knowledge). Strategic role: first-contact authority for all harbor approach, continuous observation, signal coordination with Harbor Master's Office, rapid-response coordination with Bloodaxe Rapid Response + Lords' Alliance naval. Harbor attack response (Delegation-era): Tower provided early observation and signal alert, Bloodaxe deployed in 15 minutes, 3 vessels captured. Emergency alert bell has not rung in earnest in living memory. Campaign relevance: pure strategic infrastructure, no Shi'van direct interface at Day 729. Observation records are latent intelligence asset (vessel-arrival logs accessible by institutional writ). Harper delegation arrival pathway. Lord Balaeros historical research touches Sage Kellam's broader Waterdhavian institutional history work at Font of Knowledge.
property_snapshot.Source File: WotC canon: Waterdeep: Dragon Heist (5E), City of Splendors: Waterdeep (3.5E), Volo's Guide to Waterdeep (2E), Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3E.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No surface authority. Jurisdictionally external to Waterdeep. The Skulls of Skullport (3 floating quasi-sentient skulls, historically neutrality enforcers, apprentices of Halaster Blackcloak who survived catastrophic transformation, currently reduced in activity but still present, capable of speech and destructive magic if provoked). Xanathar Guild growing institutional presence (expanding dominance, primary surface-criminal overlay, Guild's beholder leader resident in upper Undermountain). Zhentarim older commercial presence (trade networks, mercantile reach). Harpers undercover observation (monitor slave trade, Zhentarim ops, Xanathar expansion). Bregan D'aerthe commercial operator (Jarlaxle's standing interest, Arik-side aluminum trade logistics). Non-BD drow houses, duergar traders, beholders, mind flayer agents, miscellaneous Underdark powers. The Boneboard (informal merchant council, commercial dispute resolution, advisory not binding, respected because alternative is violence). Population 2000-4000 permanent + rotating transient (traders/smugglers/slavers/adventurers). Multi-racial: drow, duergar, beholders, mind flayers, humanoids of all surface origins, formorians, dragons' emissaries.
property_snapshot.Name: Skullport
property_snapshot.Notes: Subterranean port city on Undermountain Level 3. Vast cavern system (\~5 miles interior), ceiling 60-300 ft, flat central floor rising to gallery levels. River Sargauth enters through Firegulp waterfall (northeastern wellhead), exits via lower passages to distant waters. Districts: Porthaven (waterfront docks, cargo handling, day-and-night shifts), Marketwall (central commercial gallery district, shops/taverns/flesh-markets/magical-goods), Slave Market (flesh-trade section, operates openly, significant portion of city's economy), Fluted Tower (mixed residential/administrative, eastern wall), Skulls' Chamber (gallery-level sacred space), Lower Passages (routes to Undermountain 4-5), Upper Ways (Yawning Portal public route, Chamber of Mournful Dead restricted route, lesser-known stair-and-tunnel routes). Jurisdictionally external to Waterdeep — no Masked Lords/Open Lord/Watchful Order/Watch jurisdiction. Skulls of Skullport (3 Halaster-apprentice remnants) historically enforced neutrality, currently reduced. Xanathar Guild growing dominance. Zhentarim older commercial presence. Harpers undercover. Bregan D'aerthe commercial. Commerce-over-violence tradition stabilizer. For Shi'van operations: not entered. Drow cover does not transplant (surface-integrated drow reads as suspicious in Skullport). BD channel endpoint (Valas operational line reaches Skullport via BD). Arik operational overlap (aluminum trade logistics almost certainly touch Skullport, unsurfaced sibling asymmetry). Petra Voss / Ship Kurth Fish St thread potentially terminates in Skullport commercial identities. Mistshore-Skullport contractor pipeline (Xanathar Guild recruiters deliver bodies from Mistshore, Firth Observer Network traces). Merileth's Northwatch Consulting occasional Skullport-sourced intel via intermediaries. Harper-alliance proxy via Laeral is feasible institutional pathway for future action but not currently operational.
property_snapshot.Source File: WotC canon: Skullport (2E boxed set), City of Splendors: Waterdeep (3.5E), Waterdeep: Dragon Heist (5E), Dungeon of the Mad Mage (5E), Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3E.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No standing empire garrison in the forest proper. Way-station Bloodaxe details: \~12 stations × 6-12 operatives each = \~100-140 security personnel distributed along the Timber Road. Emergency reinforcement: a Bloodaxe mobile company can deploy from Neverwinter within two days; from Silverymoon within three. Veil operatives on ongoing surveillance deployment (engineered-lycanthropy investigation, secondary shadow-feeder monitoring) — count unspecified, field-rotation basis. Moonwood Glade has no garrison; its pre-human wardings are the security.
property_snapshot.Name: Moonwood
property_snapshot.Notes: Ancient forest between Neverwinter-area and Silver Marches approaches. Contains Moonwood Glade — pre-human warded neutral meeting ground with absolute anti-scrying, consent-required teleportation, and conversation privacy enchantments. Silver-barked trees in natural amphitheater pattern 'too regular for coincidence'; draconic-accommodating stone landing pads; phosphorescent underbrush. Canonical Glade use: **28 Flamerule 1494 DR — Arik Baen's summit with the gold dragon Aurixilath**, staged under Ulthaxor transport with Frieren + Lirien as attendants. Summit established preliminary metallic-dragon alliance against the Garden Keeper and Valdraxxis. Current Baen infrastructure: **Timber Road** (3-wagons-abreast, 120 miles Neverwinter to Silverymoon, 12 way-stations with Bloodaxe security, crystal communication nodes, refugee corridor during recent Silver Marches crisis). Active threat: **engineered lycanthropy operation** — unidentified party creating forced werewolves, evidence surfaced via blood forensics (Sania Valmorra hematomantic analysis), perpetrator not yet identified, Veil monitoring ongoing. Forest's druidic presence has not yet been canonically engaged. Glade remains available for future ancient-power diplomacy (Keeper contact, Valdraxxis operations, continental elvish/fey envoys).
property_snapshot.Source File: conversation canon (Aurixilath summit + Silver Marches exodus scenes); no dedicated project-knowledge .md file

property_snapshot.Garrison: No permanent staff. Senior seamstresses rotate from Institut floor as protection commissions require (Rosalie Hatch schedules). Shi'van, Rosalie, and Firth carry keys. Marcel has key, rarely visits. Ward-thresholds at both entrances (Pharyn installation).
property_snapshot.Name: The Atelier (Baen'und Original Workshop)
property_snapshot.Notes:
Original Baen'und workshop, predating the Institut. Three-story commercial building on Moonstar Lane, North Ward, \~8,000 sq ft + basement. Ground floor: traditional custom workshop (4-5 senior seamstresses rotating from Institut), public consultation, Shi'van's personal workbench. Second floor: three discrete fitting chambers, separate alley entrance, protection network hub — 17 noblewomen fitted, zero successful attacks since implementation. Trauma-sensitive fitting protocols developed here. Third floor: locked at all times (Shi'van + Rosalie keys only). Protection garments inventory (code names, never real names), confidential client files, high-value materials (star-iron wire, phase spider silk, mithril thread). Basement: panic room / safe house for up to 4 people — 14-hour emergency shelter, medical supplies, 500gp emergency funds, identity papers, sending stone to estate. Hidden exit to chandler's cellar two buildings east (chandler paid 25gp/quarter retainer through Northwatch Advisory, doesn't know what's in his wall). Used once for a protection client's domestic emergency.

The Atelier is trust. The Institut is production. The showroom is presentation. Protection network operates here because the building provides discrete access, invisible client flow, and security no other facility matches.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Callum Firth (primary authority). Brannock (field operative, prisoner delivery). Tesserly (field operative, senior access). Access compartmentalized to Firth tight circle. One trained-operative hold capacity confirmed (Margaster specialist, Day 584–592+). Covered by 550gp/month Observer Network budget.
property_snapshot.Name: 14 Nethpranter Street — Holding Cellar (Observer Network)
property_snapshot.Notes: Observer Network holding location and sensitive-meeting safehouse. Cellar at 14 Nethpranter Street, Waterdeep. Established Session 21 Day 584 when Firth's coverage expanded to 550gp/month. Held the Margaster specialist through Commerce Court hearing period. Hosted Peri emissary Doyle coordination meeting (Session 27 Day 630). Same street as the Kenafin dead drop alley (behind Coffinmaker's shop) — proximity creates mild counter-surveillance exposure but Firth tradecraft compensates. Secondary function: sensitive Observer Network meetings off Estate/tavern record. Compartmentalized to Firth, Brannock, Tesserly, Doyle (Peri), Shi'van. Not shared with Marcel, Einar, Merileth, Edmund, Violet, Silverhair, staff, Seren.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Vajra Safahr (Archmage of Waterdeep, bearer of the Blackstaff, principal resident). Senior membership of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors operating from the Tower's adjudication, research, and licensing functions. Tower wards (extra-dimensional architecture — larger on the inside, reconfiguring stair arrangements, institutional-grade magical defenses that scale with threat). Fixed teleportation circles on a dedicated floor, institutionally controlled. Watchful Order membership at large (non-resident, but operationally tied to the Tower). No standing martial garrison — the Tower's defenses are magical, and the institutional authority of the Blackstaff office is the deeper deterrent.
property_snapshot.Name: Blackstaff Tower
property_snapshot.Notes: Seat of the Archmage of Waterdeep. Castle Ward. Dark stone tower with extra-dimensional interior (larger on the inside, reconfiguring passageways). Headquarters of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors — Waterdeep's institutional wizards' guild. Current Blackstaff: Vajra Safahr. Signature property of the building: it is institutionally impossible to force entry. Teleportation circles on dedicated floor are part of the Sword Coast's fixed-installation long-range travel backbone — institutional control of teleportation is part of the Tower's operational authority. Institut de Tissage Arcanique holds a 2,000,000gp research partnership with the Watchful Order (memory thread applications, joint facility development, academic credibility). Archmage Torrino is Shi'van's weekly magical instructor; he is a Watchful Order member operating from his own tower rather than Blackstaff Tower proper, but his institutional affiliation routes through this building. Fenwick Tanglestone conducted translocation research here as Senior Conjurer before his departure — his final experiment destabilized Tower teleportation infrastructure for 11 minutes (Blackstaff Tower Incident). Tower's standing offer: return under institutional control, which Fenwick has refused. Silverhair's 40-piece Laeral ward-anchor commission (Session 9 Day 545) was coordinated with the Tower's municipal ward program. Vajra has no direct personal relationship with Shi'van at Day 729; the Waterdeep parent page flags 'offered potential future magical cooperation, monitoring magical developments in Northern Crown territory.' The relationship is latent and institutional rather than personal.
property_snapshot.Source File: Waterdeep parent page (2fbe8214-84b0-81a8); Institut page (347e8214-84b0-81a8); Fenwick Tanglestone character sheet; Session 29 Section 14 ordinance analysis.

property_snapshot.Name: Cormanthor
property_snapshot.Notes: Ancient elven forest kingdom east of the Dalelands. Capital Myth Drannor (fallen 714 DR, contested rebuilding). At Early 1495 DR: **contested and actively dying from the Verdant Corruption** — Feywild seal broke \~1492 DR, carnivorous vegetation spreading at 1 mile/month, \~40 square miles consumed, 10-year countdown to total heartland loss. Four-zone gradient from fringe (Dales border) through interior to Myth Drannor / heart (Zone 4, reality destabilization, Cult of the Dragon dracolich candidate lair, likely Shepherd substrate anchor location). Sitting Coronal government failing. **Three sitting Royal Council members secretly defected to Elara Baen'del** (constitutional crisis timed weapon) + Marshal-Commander Thessian Autumnleaf (400yr military command) + Royal Archives = Elara's legitimacy infrastructure operating from Longsaddle Valley. Yggdrasil methodology (proven at Forgedeep, scaled at Longsaddle) is the only known counter to the Corruption. **Leverage play: 'Support Elara, get salvation'** — Cormanthor's sitting government chooses between backing her claim (reclamation) or inaction (forest dies). Reclamation campaign is forward-horizon (likely post-1497-1498 continental war): Longsaddle proof-of-concept → Dalelands corridor buildout → Jörmun expedition force into Zones 3-4 → Yggdrasil deployment at scale → Elara succession activation. Drow Underdark access canonically penetrates forest roots; druidic circles compromised or in retreat; Sembian commercial pressure from south; Zhentarim cells on Zone 1-2 fringe; Cult of the Dragon Zone 3-4.
